risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified Yamaha keyboard (worst-case: not confirmed as SX-600).

risks.risk: Not actually working (keys, speakers, power supply, or controls may be faulty).
risks.proof: Short video: power on + screen/indicators on + play a few keys + show volume/speaker output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst-case: needs repair / not 100% working).

risks.risk: Missing/damaged keys or stuck keys not visible in these photos.
risks.proof: Photo/video showing the full keyboard keybed from above with all keys visible, plus a quick run-through of several keys.

risks.risk: Speaker/amp issue (built-in speaker may be weak or distorted).

risks.if_unproven: Price assuming speaker may be weak (worst-case: speaker not reliable).

Power-on video showing the display/screen and that the keyboard responds to keys.
Audio test video (play + volume control) to confirm speaker output is strong and clean.
Full keybed photo (straight-on) to confirm no missing/damaged keys.
